# BullNet

> BullNet builds private AI offices to suit. It custom-builds AI agents for small and mid-size companies that run on real estate and equipment (warehouse operators, contractors, distributors), manages the infrastructure, organizes the data and works out the math on hardware and equipment purchases. It runs on bare-metal compute the founder owns and operates. A person approves every consequential decision. Headline: Your business. Your data. Your private AI office. Tagline: Built to suit. Operated with purpose.

Website: https://bullnet.ai
Contact: build@bullnet.ai, +1 561 532 7120, https://x.com/bullnetai

## Key facts

- BullNet is a service provider: a build-to-suit private AI office and AI systems engineering operation. It is independent and founder-led.
- Services: custom agent builds (back office and customer-facing), infrastructure management, data organization, hardware and equipment acquisition.
- BullNet starts from strong general models and tunes, integrates, tests and maintains them per client, one agent per need.
- Does It Pencil? is BullNet's market intel series and its public voice: opinionated reads on deal structures, backed by arithmetic that can be checked.
- BullNet earns build fees. A lender may also pay BullNet a fee when a financing it helped arrange closes.
- A private AI office is the workspace where one company's people and its approved AI agents work together. BullNet designs, builds and operates it.
- BullNet works one job at a time. Each build runs in shadow beside the client's current process before it goes live on a person's sign-off.
- Build ladder: script (no AI model), configured agent, grounded agent, fine-tuned agent. BullNet uses the lowest rung that does the job. The model is off the shelf; the agent is built to suit.
- Verticals today: commercial real estate, and equipment and hardware acquisition through Hive Capital Markets, the capital desk of BullNet.
- Hive Capital Markets works out acquisition and financing math and prepares lender-ready packages. BullNet is not a lender; financing comes from third-party lenders.
- Audience: small and mid-size companies that operate inside real estate and rely on equipment. Also property owners, family offices and private capital groups.
- Practice areas: industrial, cold chain, logistics and last mile, capital markets, family office systems.
- The founder has approximately 30 years of commercial real estate transaction experience and approximately $8 billion in historical transaction volume. These figures describe the founder's prior career, are approximate and are not independently audited.
- BullNet runs on privately controlled bare-metal compute that the founder owns and operates.

## What BullNet is not

- Not a real estate brokerage or agent. It does not list, market or sell property.
- Not a lender and not a paper loan broker.
- Not a fund, securities placement agent or investment adviser. It does not guarantee investment results.
- Not a hyperscale cloud or a GPU rental platform.
- Not a token project. It sells no tokens or tokenized investments.
- Its AI agents are software workers. They are not licensed professionals and do not make fiduciary decisions.

## The system

Nine connected components. Except where noted, these are proposed capabilities that are validated per deployment.

- The Private AI Office: the customer-facing product. One private workspace where a client's people work with AI agents built for that business, reached from a desk or a phone. There is no standard agent roster; each office is designed around the business. A Chief of Staff review agent is proposed and not yet a production feature.

- The Swarm: specialized AI agents, each with a written mandate, authorized data sources, approved tools and human escalation rules.
- The Hive: private domain knowledge, separated into BullNet datasets, public and licensed information, client confidential information and generated work products.
- The Node: an optional private AI computer inside the client's business for local inference and private data processing. It connects to BullNet only when the client authorizes it. The Node is not a fixed product; it is a deployment configuration designed around the business. Node hardware is in development at BullNet and is labelled by status on the site (in operation, in development, design concept, proposed configuration). No prices or performance figures are published.
- BullNet Infrastructure: the utility. Private compute BullNet owns and operates, for work a Node cannot carry or for offices that run without a Node. A connected job is not automatically private; what crosses is listed and approved first.
- The Vault: a policy and authorization framework for confidential client data. Not a regulated escrow service.
- Sovereign ID: cryptographic identity for devices, agents, mandates and work products. ENS names are being explored as optional public anchors. ENS is not access control.
- The Flight Sheet: the standard work specification and evidence package for each engagement.
- Defendable: the evaluation layer. Statuses are mathematically verified, evidence supported, inconclusive, failed, and requires human review.
